s: We are well-positioned to capture this significant growth opportunity, as data centers serving artificial intelligence increasingly demand more reliable, clean power.

We believe the emerging data economy and the growing importance of artificial intelligence and continued re-shoring will require an all-of-the-above approach to generating the electricity necessary to power load in a responsible and efficient manner.

Our AWS PPA is an example of how we are powering the future in partnership with data center and artificial intelligence enterprises and, in the case of the AWS PPA, doing so with large volumes of clean, carbon-free energy.
